parameters.content:
## ERP Booking
The only place that writes to the ERP. Called by the intake, by the review screen and by the retry job. Checks ERP availability, books once (unique constraint), writes the audit entry. If the ERP is down the document waits in 'pending_erp' and an alert is raised.

parameters.query: select d.id, d.status, d.supplier_vat_id, d.invoice_number, s.available as erp_available, $2 as actor from documents d cross join erp_status s where d.id = $1::uuid

with src as (select * from documents where id = $1::uuid and status in ('pending_erp')), b as (insert into erp_invoices (document_id, supplier_vat_id, supplier_name, invoice_number, doc_type, invoice_date, due_date, currency, net_amount, vat_amount, gross_amount, po_number, booked_by) select id, supplier_vat_id, supplier_name, invoice_number, doc_type, invoice_date, due_date, currency, net_amount, vat_amount, gross_amount, po_number, $2 from src on conflict (supplier_vat_id, invoice_number) do nothing returning id), u as (update documents set status = case when exists (select 1 from b) then 'booked'::doc_status else 'duplicate'::doc_status end, erp_invoice_id = (select id from b), reasons = case when exists (select 1 from b) then reasons else reasons || '["ERP already has this supplier + invoice number."]'::jsonb end where id = $1::uuid and exists (select 1 from src) returning id, status, erp_invoice_id), a as (insert into audit_log (actor, action, document_id, after, note) select $2, case when u.status = 'booked' then 'erp_booked' else 'erp_rejected_duplicate' end, u.id, jsonb_build_object('status', u.status, 'erp_invoice_id', u.erp_invoice_id), case when u.status = 'booked' then 'Booked in ERP.' else 'ERP refused: duplicate.' end from u returning document_id) select coalesce((select status::text from u), 'not_pending') as status, (select erp_invoice_id from u) as erp_invoice_id, $1 as document_id

with u as (update documents set status = 'pending_erp' where id = $1::uuid returning id), a as (insert into audit_log (actor, action, document_id, note) select $2, 'erp_unavailable', u.id, 'ERP down for maintenance. Booking queued; retried every 5 minutes.' from u returning document_id), al as (insert into alerts (severity, source, message, details) select 'warning', 'erp-booking', 'ERP unavailable; booking queued for retry', jsonb_build_object('document_id', $1) where not exists (select 1 from alerts where source = 'erp-booking' and acknowledged = false and ts > now() - interval '30 minutes') returning id) select 'pending_erp' as status, $1 as document_id

with a as (insert into alerts (severity, source, message, details) values ('critical', 'erp-booking', 'ERP booking failed after retries: ' || $2, jsonb_build_object('document_id', $1)) returning id), l as (insert into audit_log (actor, action, document_id, note) values ('system', 'erp_error', $1::uuid, $2) returning id) select 'pending_erp' as status, $1 as document_id, $2 as error
